The execution contract is /home/user/fortress/explorations/rebuild-plan.md — read its R4 section (around line 430: "R4. **JDK 17, then 21** (full gate on 17, then on 21). Expected zero code changes (`7f71d3278`); the commit is the verification record.") plus the "Execution checklist" near the end. Where this brief and the plan file disagree, the plan file wins, but report the discrepancy.

SETUP
- Work in the worktree /home/user/fortress-clean, branch `clean-ladder`, tip must be `96c507c53` (R3, j.u.c.). Verify with `git -C /home/user/fortress-clean log --oneline -1` before starting; if the tip differs, STOP and report.
- The worktree shares .git with /home/user/fortress; inspect working-branch reference commit `7f71d3278` with `git show` first — it documents what the first ascent's JDK 17→21 rung looked like (expected: zero code changes; the commit message is the record).
- Environment: inline on EVERY ant command (shell state does not persist). For the JDK 17 gate use `/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64`, for the JDK 21 gate `/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64`:
  `export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64 && export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH && export FORTRESS_HOME=/home/user/fortress-clean && unset JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS && cd /home/user/fortress-clean && ...`
  Verify both JDKs exist first (`ls /usr/lib/jvm/`); if missing, STOP and report.

THE WORK
Expected zero source/build changes — this rung is two full verification gates on higher JDKs, recorded as one commit whose message is the verification record.
1. FULL gate on JDK 17: `ant clean compileAll`, then `ant testFast`, then `ant testSystem`.
2. FULL gate on JDK 21: same three steps with JAVA_HOME switched to java-21.
Long-suite pattern for all runs: redirect output to the scratchpad `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-fortress/bdff267d-67dc-5bb9-b970-8c3dfaa634b6/scratchpad/` with prefix `r4-` and the JDK in the name (r4-jdk17-compile.log, r4-jdk17-testfast.log, r4-jdk17-testsystem.log, r4-jdk21-...), run in background, Monitor/poll until "BUILD SUCCESSFUL" or "BUILD FAILED", then grep/tail — never cat whole logs.
Expected sums each gate: testFast 1,377 tests / 47 suites / 0F/0E (~7–8.5 min); testSystem 382 / 0F/0E (~2.5–3.5 min). `git status --short` must be EMPTY after each gate.
If compile or tests fail on either JDK: root-cause; a small, obviously-mechanical fix within this rung's scope may be applied and documented prominently (it then becomes part of the commit); anything non-mechanical → STOP and report with a grep excerpt.

COMMIT + PUSH
- If (as expected) there are zero tree changes, create the verification-record commit with `git commit --allow-empty` on clean-ladder. Message: what was verified (both full gates, JDK 17 and JDK 21, all numbers with timings), reference `7f71d3278`, note that -Xfuture was already gone since B5 so no deprecation noise. Full process detail is CORRECT at this stage (message polish happens at C2).
- The commit message MUST end with exactly this footer (two lines, after a blank line):
Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01LjDz79rDLErtnSKpovMDpX
- Never put any model identifier in the commit.
- Push: `git -C /home/user/fortress-clean push origin clean-ladder` (plain push — must fast-forward from 96c507c53; if not, STOP and report, never force-push).

CHECKLIST TICK (working branch)
- In /home/user/fortress (branch claude/handover-reading-vn8zgr), edit explorations/rebuild-plan.md: on the checklist line, change `[ ] R4 JDK 17/21` to `[x] R4 JDK 17/21 (<new sha>; <one-line summary incl. both gates' numbers>)`, leaving the rest of the line as-is. Commit ("Tick R4 (JDK 17/21) in the rebuild checklist") plus the same two-line footer, and push with `git push -u origin claude/handover-reading-vn8zgr`.
- NEVER push to main. Only the coordinator does that.

REPORT
Final report: the new clean-ladder SHA, whether the commit is empty as expected (or what changed and why), exact gate numbers for BOTH JDKs (compileAll time; testFast tests/suites/F/E + time; testSystem tests/F/E + time), any deviations, and confirmation of both pushes.
